chunks: Our ancient honour did not prevent us, nor our long-standing superiority over your people,
We mixed with you by marriage, we married you and gave our daughters in marriage to you, as equals, although you were not so!
And how could you be so when among us is the Prophet and among you is the opposer?
Among us is the Lion of Allah and among you is the Lion of the Confederates?
Among us are the two masters of the youth of Paradise and among you are the children of Hell?
Among us is the choicest of the women of the worlds and among you is the bearer of firewood?
In many things that are for us and against you!

key_terms.أَسَدُ الْأَحْلَافِ: The Lion of the Confederates (Abu Sufyan)
key_terms.حَمَّالَةُ الْحَطَبِ: The bearer of firewood (Hind bint Utbah)
key_terms.خَيْرُ نِسَاءِ الْعَالَمِينِ: The choicest of the women of the worlds (Fatima)
key_terms.سَيِّدَا شَبَابِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ: The two masters of the youth of Paradise (Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn)

ai.seo_question: What are the key distinctions Imam Ali draws between his family and the Umayyads in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) employs a rhetorical strategy of *tadhallul* (humbling oneself) to demonstrate that the Banu Hashim's marriage into the Banu Umayya was an act of grace rather than a concession of inferiority, despite the Umayyads' political dominance. He contrasts the spiritual and genealogical excellence of the Ahl al-Bayt—citing the Prophet, the Imams, and Fatima—with the specific vices of Mu'awiya, Abu Sufyan, and Hind, thereby establishing a theological hierarchy that transcends temporal power. This passage is central to Shia political theology, illustrating that legitimacy derives from divine selection and moral purity rather than mere tribal prestige or military force.

en.sayed-ali-raza: In spite of our old established honour and our well-known superiority over your people, we did not stay away from mixing with you
and married and got married (among you) like equals although you were not so.
And how could you be so when (the position is that) among us is the Prophet while among you is the opposer,
among us is the lion of Allāh while among you is the lion of the opposing groups,
among us are the two masters of the youth of Paradise [2] while among you are the children of Hell,
among us is the choicest of all the women of the worlds [3] while among you is the bearer of firewood,
and many more distinctions on our side and shortcomings on your side.
